conbody.p: Traceability, under Verify in the project menu, shows one row per requirement with columns for:

ul.li: Linked needs — user needs the requirement derives from
Design outputs — design items that satisfy it
Test cases + latest result — verifying tests, each chip showing its latest recorded result (pass / fail / blocked / not-run)
Baseline selector — view the matrix as of any baseline (read-only).
Quick filter — type to filter rows across all columns.
Export CSV — download the matrix for spreadsheets or reports.

conbody.p: On a phone the matrix is a coverage list instead of a grid:

ul.li: A summary at the top counts the requirements that are fully traced — a user need, a design output and passing tests — and those failing, with a suspect link or with a gap.
Needs attention, Failing, Suspect and All filter the list; Needs attention puts failing tests first, then suspect links, then missing links and tests not yet run.

Each requirement has a square for Need, Design, Test and Hazard, holding how many are linked. The square turns green when every test passes, red when one fails, amber for a blocked test or a suspect link, and is a dashed outline when nothing is linked where something should be. A hazard is not required, so an empty one shows a dash.
Tap a requirement for a sheet that names what needs attention and every linked artifact, each test with its latest result, with Show impact and Open requirement. Export CSV is on the desktop view.
